Title: New developer portal in Azure API Management is in development

Body.Content:
We have been working on a new, open-source developer portal offering in Azure API Management, based on our own fork of the Paperbits framework (paperbits.io). It has a modern default look and feel, and is optimized for:  

  • Customization, styling, and authoring through a built-in visual editor  
  • Programmatic access through APIs for automating development, management, and deployment  
  • Extension of the provided core functionality 

Learn more about Azure API Management
